description: Port State Control preparation items for one deficiency area (an area id such as "cert", "crew", "fire", "lsa", "nav", "mach", "pol1", "ism", "isps" — or words from the area title such as "certificates" or "fire safety"). Call without "area" to list the 24 areas. Items flagged detainableHint are commonly a ground for detention; items marked demonstrate are tests the PSC officer asks the crew to run; items with a pack apply only to the ship types listed.

area.description: Area id or words from its title. Omit to list areas.

name: psc_checklist
title: Port State Control preparation checklist
